title: PaidBench.__init__ puts a failing claude shim on PATH around Bench.__init__, which no longer starts claude, and its docstring says Bench reads the version there
goal: bench_load.PaidBench builds no failing claude shim around Bench.__init__; its docstring says where a paid run's version stays unknown (benchmarks.main presets it) since Bench.__init__ starts no claude

run: import sys,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bench_load; bench_load.Bench.__init__=lambda self,*a,**k: None; n=[]; o=bench_load.shim_dir; bench_load.shim_dir=lambda d: (n.append(1), o(d))[1]; bench_load.PaidBench(tempfile.mkdtemp(),1); sys.exit(1 if n else 0)
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bench_load; d=bench_load.PaidBench.__doc__ or ""; print(d); sys.exit(0 if "benchmarks.main" in d and "fails at once" not in d else 1)
